flashcard_questions.q: Who wrote the play Rise Up about the Freedom Riders?
Which real 1960s American protest movement does Rise Up dramatise?
What journey do the Freedom Riders make in Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: From Washington to the Southern States of America.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the genre of Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: Documentary drama, built from documented evidence about real events.

flashcard_questions.q: What performance style does Rise Up use?
How many actors perform the whole of Rise Up?
What technique lets Rise Up’s four actors play many characters?
Which nationality are the four actors in Rise Up’s play within a play?
Which Rise Up performer plays Diane Nash?
Which Rise Up performer is the only White actor in the cast?
The Freedom Riders’ bus is attacked in ____, ____ in Rise Up.
Which convention slows the bus explosion down in Rise Up?
What is a sound collage in Rise Up?
flashcard_questions.a: Multiple voices speaking simultaneously to build tension and create a climax.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do the performers in Rise Up face out towards the audience?
flashcard_questions.a: It reinforces the abstract, non-naturalistic style of the piece.
